title: Deterministic mathematical models for biological processes
institution: CIMPA (Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées) with Urgench State University
about: CIMPA research school at Urgench State University, 17-28 May 2027, on deterministic models for oncology, epidemic spread and respiratory and lung ventilation, with optimal control, asymptotic analysis and numerical methods. Applications close 17 January 2027.
